cohorts.annotation: Same Wikipedia rows/order, plus candidate-eligible original-ruby rows from #55 within current permitted paragraph scope.
cohorts.dictionary: Latest admitted source-exact dictionary-extracted rows, candidate-eligible and within current permitted paragraph scope.
cohorts.selection: Lowest stable IDs per corpus after all source and candidate checks. No replacement, repetition, evaluation-word matching, reading/form rebalancing or model-outcome selection.
cohorts.shortage: Preserve all terminal counts and stop before fitting. No quota or leakage-threshold relaxation.

acquisition.rate_limit_policy: Stop scheduling on 429/403, Retry-After, hash mismatch or unexpected failure. Drain at most two in-flight bounded requests; preserve all remaining document slots as not_attempted. No replacement.

evaluation.advance_rule: All three point differences nonnegative and mean paired 95% lower bound above zero. Secondary per-seed intervals/context/contrast metrics descriptive; no multiple-comparison winner selection. Otherwise retain current model. This is research advancement, not production admission.
evaluation.contrast_interpretation: Secondary descriptive evidence with actual group counts; no required semantic label or target support manufactured.
evaluation.contrasts: On source-isolated eligible pool, group by original-lemma basis, reading and coarse POS. At most 32 lemma/surface types per group. Deterministically select two different lemma/surface types, two examples each, with four distinct documents and bounded left contexts, per context_contrasts.py. At most 100 groups/400 rows. No converter/model outcome participates in selection.
evaluation.eligibility: Original morphemes only, reading 2..32 kana/long-vowel characters, surface 1..32 containing a CJK unified ideograph, preceding source context 8..64 characters within the same annotation unit. Exclude annotated alternatives and named entities. Preserve all exclusion counts and original annotations; no guessed readings or normalization.
evaluation.gate: Existing research margin >1.7 only; no calibration or threshold search.
evaluation.isolation: All historical/source/input metadata plus both prospective train pools and all their consumed paragraph coverage. No fresh evaluation rows or words enter training. All selected and unselected new annotation units contribute source isolation.
evaluation.main: One target per document, minimum canonical SHA256 [20261105, annotation-main, stable_id] before candidate/model outcomes. Retain all 1000 terminal document slots.
evaluation.metrics: Source-exact accuracy, rescue/harm/wrong-to-wrong, all failed corrections, error application/overall coverage, precision/recall, baseline gains, candidate presence/ranking failures, Wilson/exact 95% intervals and component paired bootstrap.
evaluation.models: Initial #29 reference plus all six final fits; never pick a seed.
evaluation.primary: One prespecified mean across three paired seed accuracy differences, annotation minus dictionary, intact/ungated main. Shared source-component bootstrap draws (2000, seed20261105).
evaluation.rights: Research feasibility/evaluation only. No model training or redistribution from KWDLC. Provider's original-author permission and source-URL limitations remain unresolved.
evaluation.selection: Bottom SHA256 [20261105, annotation-recipe-v1, document_id], excluding all 2300 exposed public-train documents; never public dev/test.
evaluation.shuffle: Same fixed role/context-length stratified cyclic permutation as #40, hash domain annotation-shuffle, seed20261105; singleton strata counted.

expected_cost: One bounded 4.8GB compressed Wikipedia pass plus source graph reconstruction and complete provenance/numeric verification; at most 3600s for source recovery and 1800s per other preparation stage. Later six 500-update fits cap at 1800s each, evaluation acquisition at 900s, CPU 10000 runs per prespecified arm.
expected_effect: Unknown; better source reading/span evidence may help, while literary distribution and unresolved IME intent may harm modern evaluation.
hypothesis: Replacing dictionary-extracted Aozora weak labels with original-ruby-base/reading weak labels improves unseen source-form ranking under equal source counts and model budget. This is a joint extraction-recipe effect, not pure reading quality.

source.history: Full #53 inventory/taint plus new Wikipedia paragraph coverage. Rebuild identity and content quarantine, preserve all old quarantine, then fresh full consumed-source/input closure.
source.source_scope: All original permitted Aozora paragraphs plus complete original paragraphs used by candidate Wikipedia train fragments. Exact original source/positions required; no body pretraining.

training.loss: Unchanged masked listwise CE with label smoothing .05
training.start_rule: Only after source/cohort/numeric verification, unused research evaluation readiness, separate committed fit binding and quality-policy validation. No evaluation arrays in fit process; all six final checkpoints fixed before any scores.
